description.en:
A certain boy and girl in middle school became lovers, flirted with each other, disagreed on trivial things, became more frequently irritated with each other rather than excited... and ended up breaking up on graduation. And so, the two of them, Irido Mizuto and Ayai Yume, wound up meeting each other in the most unexpected fashion.

"Isn't it obvious that I'm the elder brother."
"Isn't it obvious that I'm the elder sister."

The children of the partner of their parent's remarriage was their ex-lover!? The former couple, mindful of their parent's feelings, decided on a 'sibling rule' where the one takes conscious of the other as the opposite sex loses, but— When they encounter each other in the bathroom, commute to and from school together... along with the memories of the past and living under the same roof, just how do they disregard each other!?

description.en:
"Everything for the Score"—nicknamed "Esco"—is a renowned masterpiece in the world of yuri games. A boy who reincarnates into its world suddenly finds himself in the role of Sanjo Hiro, infamously known as "the guy who gets in the way of yuri."

Hiro is a nuisance character who ends up ruined no matter which route he's in. To avoid triggering his death flags, he begins to train and search for a safe path—but for some reason, heroine events keep unfolding around him as the central figure...!?

"I don't want a harem romcom! Just give me yuri! Let me see the yuri!"
___
[Official English Light Novel](https://yenpress.com/series/the-only-thing-i-d-do-in-a-no-boys-allowed-game-world-novel)
description.id:
"Everything for the Score"—atau yang biasa dikenal sebagai "Esco"—adalah mahakarya terkenal dalam dunia game yuri. Seorang remaja yang bereinkarnasi ke dalam dunia game tersebut tiba-tiba menyadari bahwa dirinya kini adalah Sanjo Hiro, karakter pengganggu yang dibenci dan dijuluki “cowok yang nyempil di antara pasangan yuri.”

Hiro adalah karakter pengacau yang selalu berakhir tragis, apa pun rutenya. Untuk menghindari kematian, ia mulai berlatih dan mencari safe rute—tapi entah kenapa, justru berbagai event heroine malah terus terjadi dengan dia sebagai pusatnya...!?

“Aku enggak mau romcom harem! Tunjukin yuri-nya! Aku cuma mau lihat yuri!”
description.ja: 『Everything for the Score』――通称「エスコ」。百合ゲームの傑作と名高い作品の世界に転生した少年は、気づけばゲーム内随一のお邪魔キャラ、"百合の間に挟まる男"で悪名高い「三条燈色」になっていた。燈色はどんなルートでも破滅してしまう。彼は死亡フラグ回避のためのルートを見つけるべく鍛錬するが、なぜか自分を中心にヒロイン達とのイベントが展開されてしまい……？ハーレムラブコメは求めてねぇ！百合を、百合を見せてくれ！
description.vi:
"Everything for the score"—biệt danh "Esco"—là một kiệt tác nổi tiếng trong giới game bách hợp. Một chàng trai sau khi tái sinh vào thế giới này đã thấy mình vào vai Sanjo Hiro, một cái tên nổi tiếng với biệt danh "Kẻ ngáng đường yuri".

Hiro là một nhân vật phiền toái với một kết cục là bị trừ khử bất kể là trong tuyến truyện nào của game. Để tránh gặp phải tình huống tương tự, cậu trai của ta bắt đầu luyện tập và tìm kiếm một con đường thoát thân—nhưng vì lý do nào đó, các nữ chính cứ bu lấy anh ấy như thể anh là nhân vật chính...!?

"Tôi không muốn một câu chuyện hài lãng mạn harem đâu! Tôi muốn bách hợp cơ! Làm ơn chỉ bách hợp thôi!"

description.en:
"Just kill me!" These are the words of Serafina de Lavillant, the strongest female knight in the West. After being defeated in a war with the East, she has become a prisoner of the barbarians! What awaits the captive Serafina is a life of revenge, torture, and humiliation... or so she thought! What she is offered instead is a marriage to the barbarian king!?
___
Note: "Barbaroi" (バルバロイ) is the Japanization of "βάρβαροι", the plural Greek word for non-Greeks (foreigners). (In English, we have "barbarians".) Interestingly, the pronunciation of the Japanization lines up with the Ancient Greek pronunciation (/bár.ba.roi̯/) rather than the Modern Greek pronunciation (/ˈvar.va.ri/).

Shion, the "Hero of Darkness", was said to be the strongest hero ever. He believed one thing, and that was his current party members.
  
"I'll defeat the Demon Lord with this party!"
  
That is what he swore to do, but a tragedy occurs. He was painfully betrayed by the girls that he trusted.  He barely held onto his life, but the incident left a deep scar in his heart. He gave up on living, and while he was wandering around in a forest, looking for a way to die, a single monster appeared in front of him.

"Eu vou derrotar o Lorde Demônio com essa party!"

description.en: A boy is initially overjoyed at the news of him having an older sister, due to his father remarrying to a woman who has a daughter. That is, until he finds out that his new sister is actually his school's strict PE teacher, Shina. With his father going off to live with his new wife, the boy will live alone with his new sister. In their new life together, the boy finds out that Shina at home is completely different from Shina at work: clumsy, scared of insects, and kind.
description.id: Seorang anak laki-laki awalnya sangat gembira mendengar kabar bahwa dia akan memiliki seorang kakak perempuan karena ayahnya menikah lagi dengan seorang wanita yang memiliki seorang anak perempuan. Namun, kegembiraanya itu terhenti saat dia mengetahui bahwa saudara perempuan barunya itu adalah guru olahraga sekolahnya yang super ketat, Shiina. Dikarenakan Ayahnya pergi berbulan madu bersama istri barunya, anak laki-laki tersebut akan tinggal berdua saja dengan saudara perempuan barunya itu. Dalam kehidupan bersama baru mereka, si anak laki-laki tersebut mengetahui bahwa Shiina di rumah sangatlah berbeda dengan Shiina saat di tempat bekerja; canggung, takut pada serangga, dan baik hati.
description.ja: 父さんが再婚したら、相手には娘さんがいて、義弟の僕を可愛がる気満々だって？少年が想像しまくる最高な展開を希望していたのに、待っていたのは絶望だった？なぜなら義姉は、僕が通う学校で厳しすぎると評判の体育教師・獅那先生だったから！新婚を満喫したい両親は二人暮らしのために家を出て行ってしまい、鬼教師と同棲することに。そんな生活きつすぎる！と思っていたけれど、家の中では無防備すぎて目のやり場に困ったり、ポンコツだったり、意外な一面が見えてきた。そして何より、義姉が僕のことを好きすぎて超優しいのだ！
description.pt-br: A história acompanha um rapaz que inicialmente fica muito feliz com a notícia de ter uma irmã mais velha devido ao seu pai se casar novamente com uma mulher que já tem uma filha, até que ele descobre que a sua nova irmã é na realidade a sua estrita professora de educação física da sua escola, Shina. Com o pai saindo de casa para morar com a sua nova esposa, o rapaz vai morar sozinho com a sua nova irmã. Na sua nova vida juntos, o rapaz descobre que Shina no trabalho é completamente diferente da Shina em casa: desajeitada, com medo de insetos e gentil.

description.es:
Verlo trae desgracia; profanarlo, trae una maldición... Introduciendo una nueva era de extrañeza, ¡abandonando la seriedad!

En un día de tormenta, un desprendimiento de tierra destruye una cerca, y unos hermanos que se aventuraron en una zona prohibida durante mucho tiempo se encuentran con una criatura terroríficamente extraña...
"¡Soy un dios maldito! ¡¿No te importa nada esta forma grotesca?!?"
Los imperturbables hermanos, en lugar de asustarse, llaman casualmente a la criatura "Dara-San" y ¡le cogen cariño!?

Parece que da miedo, ¡pero no! Una nueva era de comedia ocultista que deja atrás la seriedad.

The sudden reunion lifts Fuyu's spirits, who wastes no time inviting Ito to chat over drinks. The two have a whale of a time sharing gripes and reminiscing about the past. Vui mừng vì cuộc hội ngộ bất ngờ, Fuyu đã rủ Ito đi uống và tâm sự về những chuyện cũ. Họ nghĩ rằng mối quan hệ bạn bè như thế này cũng tốt, nhưng rồi lại phạm phải sai lầm chỉ sau một đêm...
description.es-la:
Fuyu Yamase, un joven adulto cansado de su agotador trabajo llama a su ex novia en la universidad, Ito Minase, para tomar unos tragos. Comieron, rieron, recordaron anécdotas de la universidad; eso hizo que Fuyu piense que esa relación con Ito era perfecta, sin embargo, tragos van, tragos vienen y terminaron ‘haciéndolo’. 

Arrepentido por lo sucedido, Fuyu trata de disculparse con Ito pero ella piensa que está bien lo que sucedió, ya que no hicieron nada malo, al contrario, fue algo divertido porque ambos se sintieron cómodos. Ito estaba cansada de lo complicado que es era ser en la vida por ser una adulta, por lo que ambos deciden tener una relación donde simplemente se diviertan sin preocuparse por el trabajo o el amor.

description.en: My first impression of Ryuuga was “This is the kind of protagonist you’d see in something like an anime.” Then, that thought soon changed into conviction. First of all, this guy almost never talks about his past. Also, he frequently slips out of class. As soon as he comes back, he gets extremely tired, blood comes out from his lips, the sleeves and cuffs of his uniform get torn, and so forth. Furthermore, there’s always beauties that are surrounding Ryuuga. The one who’s like an idol within the school, Yukimiya Shiori. The cool expert of the sword, Aogasaki Rei. The mysterious transfer student, Elmira McCartney. It’s very tiring for me when these people appear in front of Ryuuga. I have to frantically make a fuss by saying things like “H, hey Ryuga! How did you get acquainted with Yukimiya!”, “W, why did the beautiful swordswoman Aogasaki come to the classroom to specifically meet Ryuga?!”, or “E, E, Elmira! What is it that you see in Ryuga!” …So why am I doing this? That’s because I, Kobayashi Ichirou, am a pro at being a friend. My life’s calling is to support Hinomori Ryuuga, the protagonist amongst protagonists, as a close friend character. ―Let the curtains open for the rom-com presented by co-starring best friend, Kobayashi Ichirou! Based from a popular LN now in Manga form!
description.ja: 主人公の活躍を彩る親友キャラこそ俺の生き様――最強〝助演〟コメディ！
description.pt: Eu encontrei meu herói ideal! Meu amigo Hinomori Ryuuga. O melhor amigo que fiz no ensino médio. Minha primeira impressão dele foi: “É como um personagem heroico de um anime”. E essa impressão rapidamente mudou. Por um lado, ele quase nunca fala sobre seu passado. Ele muitas vezes pula as aulas e quando ele volta, sua boca está sagrando, ou suas roupas estão rasgadas ou algo assim. Além disso, há sempre lindas garotas ao seu redor. A ídolo da escola Yukimiya Shiori, a linda espadachim, Aogasaki Satori, a misteriosa aluna transferida, Elmira Maccatney. Toda vez que elas aparecem ao redor de Ryuuga, eu me sinto extremamente cansado. Isso porque toda vez que elas se envolvem com ele, eu me vejo desesperadamente gritando coisas como: “H-Hey, Ryuuga! Como você é amigo da Yukimiya-san ?!” E “P-por que uma bela espadachim como Aogasaki-san veio à nossa turma para te ver Ryuuga ?!” E “Elmira-san! Veio ver o Ryuuga ?!” … Então, por que eu faço isso? É porque eu, Kobayashi Ichiro, sou um amigo profissional. Desempenhar o papel do melhor amigo que apoia Hinomori Ryuuga, o herói dos heróis, é o meu estilo de vida. O começo de uma comédia romântica apresentada pelo personagem secundário, Melhor amigo, Kobayashi!

High schooler Shinomiya Raku was reincarnated due to a wicked god toying with his fate, which ended in his untimely death in the previous world. 

Reborn as Larucu, a silver-haired boy, he possesses super convenient skills he received as an apology for his death, and is now filled with great hope to lead a fulfilling, smooth-sailing second life. However, he was soon struck by a series of catastrophic events, starting by getting expelled from his family and then collapsing down the road. 

But through his intrinsic honesty and versatile initial skills, he manages to overcome his unfortunate circumstances and becomes the adventurer he's dreamed of being and enjoys his new life to the fullest!

The curtain rises on the fantasy adventure of this child prodigy who has limitless potential!

description.en:
My childhood friend, Magary, was chosen to be the saint. From here on out, she'll have to maintain a smile at all times while at the royal capital and take lessons in etiquette and dance. She'll be living in an excruciatingly stifling world. Having been together since birth, there was naturally one thought in my mind.

While feeling a little bit of loneliness... I pushed my childhood friend (who was trying to escape with all her might with her arms still bound) towards the knight that came to pick her up.

"Alistaaaaaaaaaaaaar!!"
  
I feel as if there was some deep resentment in her voice, but that's probably just my imagination. As her last act of futile resistance, she had me see her off to the royal capital… but, that ended without any problems.

"Now that that's over with, I'll be heading home. Good luck ^^"

I turned my back towards my childhood friend who looked me with deep resentment in her eyes. While I was making my way home... I had to turn around as I was chased by goblins.

"Noooooooo!! Someone, helpppppppp!!"

description.en:
One day, the chairs in the Literature Club were lent out to other clubs, leaving only a single chair behind.
Kakeru and Yuzu began a lighthearted argument, each trying to yield the remaining seat to the other.
Each wanted the other to sit more than themselves. Because of their mutual kindness, neither would back down, resulting in a stalemate—until finally, Yuzu’s opinion won out, and Kakeru ended up sitting in the chair alone.
Kakeru felt guilty being the only one sitting, but right then, he had a flash of inspiration.

“Since I'm the one sitting in the chair, if I become the chair and let Yuzu-senpai sit on my lap… wouldn't that work?”

…Or so he thought.

description.en:
I reincarnated as Iriya Satoshi, a mob character in a gal game world. But for some reason, the heroines are worshipping me?!
And to make matter worse, every single one of them is a complete yandere...

"I'm sorry. Please don't throw me away. Don't hate me."
"...I only have eyes for you. We'll be together forever, right?"

The actual protagonist is right there, so why are they all coming after me?!

By the way... where did my [Diary] go?
description.id:
Para heroine berubah menjadi yandere berbahaya yang memuja diriku. Kenapa…?
“…Aku sudah tidak bisa melihat siapa pun selain dirimu. Mari bersama selamanya, ya?“
Aku yang terlahir kembali di dunia gal game, sedang dikejar-kejar oleh para heroine.
Namun, ada satu masalah.
“Maafkan aku. Jangan tinggalkan aku. Jangan membenciku.“
“Aku hanya akan mengabdi pada Satoshi-kun saja—sampai mati.“
“Satoshi-sama. Aku akan membalas budi baikmu yang telah menyelamatkanku seumur hidupku.“
Yaitu, semua heroine ini ternyata sakit!
Kenapa bisa mereka menjadi seperti ini!?
——Ngomong-ngomong, ke mana perginya [buku harian]-ku?
description.ja:
ギャルゲー世界のモブ・入谷聡に転生した俺のことを、
なぜかヒロインたちが崇拝してくる!?
しかも、全員かなり病んでいて……。

「ごめんなさい。私を捨てないで。嫌いにならないで」
「……私はもう君のことしか見えてないから。ずっと一緒にいようね？」

正規ルートの主人公がいるのに、みんなどうして俺に迫ってくるんだ？

――ところで、俺の【日記帳】はどこにいったんだろう？
description.pt-br:
Eu reencarnei como Iriya Satoshi, um personagem secundário no mundo de um gal game. Mas, por algum motivo, as heroínas estão me adorando?!

E para piorar as coisas, cada uma delas é uma yandere completa...

"Sinto muito. Por favor, não me jogue fora. Não me odeie."

"...Eu só tenho olhos para você. Nós vamos ficar juntos para sempre, não é?"

O verdadeiro protagonista está bem ali, então por que todas elas estão vindo atrás de mim?!

description.en:
As the monster's teeth drew near, it was then that I remembered. "I've witnessed this scene before." This was the world of an RPG I played in my previous life. And I, as the main character's childhood friend, was the losing love interest who would be turned down by him in the future. The childhood friend whose role ended one hour into the opening after confessing to the main character as he was about to set off into his journey. The one many players sympathized with as the main character would meet another girl who would cling onto him during his journey. If I remain in this village, in the future I'll be the losing love interest?! To prevent that from happening, I'll leave the village and make use of my newly blossomed ability in compounds with becoming an alchemist at the royal capital as my aim. I don't give a damn about some job that requires me to be the main character's childhood friend. I'll be seizing happiness with my own hands!

---
**Original Web Serialization:** [Comic Walker](https://comic-walker.com/contents/detail/KDCW_FL00201503010000_68/), [NicoVideo](https://manga.nicovideo.jp/comic/46466)

[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n0552ep/)
description.fr: Alors que les dents du monstre se rapprochaient, c'est alors que je me souvins. «J'ai déjà été témoin de cette scène.» C'était le monde d'un RPG auquel j'ai joué dans ma vie précédente. Et moi, en tant qu'ami d'enfance du personnage principal, j'étais l'amoureuse perdante qui sera rejeté par lui à l'avenir. L'ami d'enfance dont le rôle s'est terminé une heure après le début du jeu, après avoir avoué mes sentiments au personnage principal alors qu'il était sur le point de se lancer dans son voyage. Celui avec lequel de nombreux joueurs sympathisaient en tant que personnage principal rencontrerait une autre fille qui s'attacherai à lui pendant son voyage. Si je reste dans ce village, à l'avenir je serai l'amoureuse perdante?! Pour éviter que cela ne se produise, je vais quitter le village et utiliser une nouvelle capacité que j'ai acquise avec comme objectif de devenir alchimiste dans la capitale royale. Je me fous d'un travail qui m'oblige à être l'ami d'enfance du personnage principal. Je vais saisir le bonheur de mes propres mains!
description.id: Saat gigi monster itu mendekat, saat itulah aku ingat. "Saya telah menyaksikan adegan ini sebelumnya." Ini adalah dunia RPG yang kumainkan di kehidupanku sebelumnya. Dan aku, sebagai teman masa kecil tokoh utama, adalah kehilangan minat cinta yang akan ditolak olehnya di masa depan. Teman masa kecil yang perannya berakhir satu jam ke pembukaan setelah mengakui karakter utama saat ia akan berangkat ke perjalanannya. Satu-satunya pemain yang bersimpati sebagai tokoh utama akan bertemu gadis lain yang akan menempel padanya selama perjalanannya. Jika aku tetap di desa ini, di masa depan aku akan kehilangan minat cinta?! Untuk mencegah hal itu terjadi, aku akan meninggalkan desa dan memanfaatkan kemampuan baru saya berkembang dalam senyawa dengan menjadi seorang alkemis di ibukota kerajaan sebagai tujuan saya. Saya tidak peduli tentang beberapa pekerjaan yang mengharuskan saya untuk menjadi teman masa kecil tokoh utama. Aku akan merebut kebahagiaan dengan tanganku sendiri!
description.ja:
幼馴染の勇者様、私のことはキレイさっぱり忘れてくれて、結構です!!
ゲームの世界で“幼馴染として勇者に告白したのに忘れ去られる負けヒロイン”に転生したラウラ。悲惨な運命から逃れようと調合師を目指したら、思いがけない才能が…！ 
ところが、本来登場しないはずのキャラクター・アルノルトに出会い、ラウラは前世の記憶と現世の違いに気づく。―――それは、やがて世界を救う勇者である幼馴染・ルカーシュの未来も左右しかねなくて……!? 
運命なんかに絶対負けない！　頑張る女の子の異世界転生ストーリー！
description.ru: Когда передо мной распахнулась пасть зверя, я поняла, что однажды уже пережила эти события. Это был мир RPG, в которую я играла в моей прошлой жизни. И я - подруга детства главного героя, который в будущем отвергнет меня. Если я останусь в этой деревне, моё будущее не изменится?! Чтобы предотвратить это, я перееду в столицу и воспользуюсь своими новообретёнными навыками, чтобы стать алхимиком. Меня не заботит роль простой подруги детства главного героя. W realnym świecie jest socjopatką, która zupełnie nie radzi sobie z komunikacją z innymi ludźmi, a w szczególności z płcią przeciwną. Manga opowiada o jej kuriozalnych próbach (z reguły niezbyt udanych) usocjalnienia się i zmienienia się w osobę bardziej popularną.
description.es-la: Kuroki Tomoko, una chica que tiene "50 años de experiencia" en citas y que ha salido con más de un centenar de chicos… en juegos otome. En la vida real acaba de cumplir 15 años y va a dar comienzo su época en el instituto, está convencida de que con sus conocimientos será la más de popular. Una vez comienza el instituto, comienzan a pasar los días y se da cuenta de que no habla con nadie. ¿Cómo es posible? Un simple vistazo al espejo le hace darse cuenta de la realidad: no es precisamente una belleza y parece que hasta puede ser antipática. Poco a poco intentará cambiar para ser popular, pero claro, entre lo que le cuesta y lo que tiene una idea bastante distorsionada de la realidad, no será tan sencillo.
description.pt-br:

description.en:
From Viz:
Ichigo Kurosaki has always been able to see ghosts, but this ability doesn't change his life nearly as much as his close encounter with Rukia Kuchiki, a Soul Reaper and member of the mysterious Soul Society. While fighting a Hollow, an evil spirit that preys on humans who display psychic energy, Rukia attempts to lend Ichigo some of her powers so that he can save his family; but much to her surprise, Ichigo absorbs every last drop of her energy. Now a full-fledged Soul Reaper himself, Ichigo quickly learns that the world he inhabits is one full of dangerous spirits and, along with Rukia, who is slowly regaining her powers, it's Ichigo's job to protect the innocent from Hollows and help the spirits themselves find peace.

Ja samalla myös työtarjouksen, josta on vaikea kieltäytyä… Tämän- ja tuonpuoleisen rajat ylittävä toiminnantäyteinen seikkailu voi alkaa! 

Suositellaan yli 12-vuotiaille. Sarjakuva etenee takakannesta etukanteen ja oikealta vasemmalle. Teksti on suomeksi.
description.fr: Adolescent de quinze ans, Ichigo Kurosaki possède un don particulier: celui de voir les esprits. Un jour, il croise la route d'une belle Shinigami (un être spirituel) en train de pourchasser une «âme perdue,» un esprit maléfique qui hante notre monde et n'arrive pas à trouver le repos.Mise en difficulté par son ennemi, la jeune fille décide alors de prêter une partie de ses pouvoirs à Ichigo, mais ce dernier hérite finalement de toute la puissance du Shinigami. Contraint d'assumer son nouveau statut, Ichigo va devoir gérer ses deux vies: celle de lycéen ordinaire, et celle de chasseur de démons... Bleach est l'oeuvre d'un mangaka prometteur, Taito Kubo, et le dernier succès des Editions Shueisha. Manga d'action au rythme trépidant, au graphisme soigné et à l'intrigue palpitante, Bleach est la nouvelle bonne surprise du manga au pays du Soleil Levant.
description.id: Ichigo Kurosaki (15 tahun) bisa melihat hantu. Ichigo menjalani hari-hari yang damai dengan kemampuan khususnya itu. Tiba-tiba dia bertemu dengan gadis yang menamakan dirinya Shinigami dan diserang roh jahat yang disebut "Hollow". Dimulailah pertarungan panjang Ichigo.
description.it: Arriva finalmente in Italia il manga di Tite Kubo, che sta facendo letteralmente impazzire i lettori di tutto il mondo. Premio Shogakukan 2005 come miglior shonen, è la storia di Ichigo Kurosaki, un ragazzo dotato di un’abilità molto particolare: è in grado di vedere i fantasmi. E se la sua vita è già pazzesca a causa di questo dono, immaginate cosa gli potrebbe succedere se diventasse… un dio della morte?! Un intreccio appassionante, animato da un cast di personaggi estremamente variegato e impreziosito da uno stile di disegno attentissimo ai dettagli e originale nella fusione effettuata di vecchie e nuove tendenze, strizzando l’occhio, soprattutto per quanto riguarda l’abbigliamento dei personaggi, alla moda alternativa streetwear. Da “Bleach”, serializzato su “Weekly Shonen Jump”, è stata tratta anche una serie animata, il cui primo episodio è stato trasmesso in Giappone nel 2004 e che sta riscuotendo tutt’ora un grande successo.

description.tr: Ichigo Kurosaki her zaman hayaletleri görebilmiştir, ancak bu yeteneği onun hayatını, bir Ruh Emici ve gizemli Ruh Topluluğu üyesi olan Rukia Kuchiki ile yakın karşılaşması kadar değiştirmez. Psişik enerji sergileyen insanları avlayan kötü bir ruh olan Hollow ile savaşırken, Rukia ailesini kurtarabilmesi için Ichigo'ya güçlerinin bir kısmını ödünç vermeye çalışır, ancak Ichigo onu şaşırtacak şekilde enerjisinin son damlasına kadar emer.   Artık tam teşekküllü bir Ruh Emici olan Ichigo, içinde yaşadığı dünyanın tehlikeli ruhlarla dolu olduğunu çabucak öğrenir ve güçlerini yavaş yavaş geri kazanan Rukia ile birlikte, Ichigo'nun görevi hem masumları Hollow'lardan korumak hem de ruhların kendilerinin huzur bulmasına yardımcı olmaktır.

Він змалку здатен бачити і спілкуватися із духами. Та після зустрічі з дівчиною-шініґамі Рукією він отримує нові здібності, а разом з ними і обов'язки захищати світ від злих духів.
description.vi:
Kurosaki Ichigo là một học sinh cấp 3 có khả năng nhìn thấy linh hồn. Một ngày nọ, cậu tình cờ gặp Kuchikia Rukia – một cô gái tự xưng là Tử thần đến từ Soul Society. Ichigo không ngờ rằng, cuộc gặp ấy đã hoàn toàn thay đổi cuộc đời cậu.

Để bảo vệ gia đình mình, Ichigo đã nhận lấy sức mạnh từ Rukia để chiến đấu với Hollow. Tuy nhiên, cậu vô tình chiếm hết toàn bộ sức mạnh của Rukia khiến cô không thể quay về Soul Society. Trong lúc chờ sức mạnh của Rukia phục hồi, Ichigo buộc phải thay cô gánh vác nhiệm vụ của một Tử thần, đó là dẫn độ linh hồn người chết sang thế giới bên kia và tiêu diệt Hollow - những linh hồn xấu đe dọa đến các linh hồn khác và cả con người…
description.es-la: Lo que Ichigo Kurosaki menos hubiera deseado tener, era la habilidad de poder ver fantasmas. Una serie de sucesos lo convierten en un Shinigami, dedicando su vida a proteger a los inocentes y ayudando a que los espíritus atormentados encuentren la paz en la Sociedad de Almas. Lo ayudan varios de sus amigos que cuentan con capacidades espirituales. También Urahara y Rukia, la shinigami que le cedió sus poderes.
description.pt-br: Kurosaki Ichigo é um estudante de 15 anos que tem uma estranha capacidade de ver, tocar e falar com espíritos de pessoas mortas. Logo que o Shinigami (Deus da Morte) Kuchiki Rukia toma conhecimento dos poderes dele ela decide investigá-lo, e acaba em uma luta com um Hollow que foi atraído pelo forte poder espiritual de Ichigo, antes de ser derrotada pela criatura, Rukia passa seus poderes a Ichigo, o qual se torna um Shinigami, e após derrotar o Hollow ingressa em uma jornada para proteger os humanos e os espíritos da ameaça dos Hollows.

biography.en:
His real name is Kubo Noriaki.

He started drawing manga because he liked GeGeGe no Kitaro and Saint Seiya as a child.

The son of a town council member in Fuchu, Aki District, Hiroshima, Kubo graduated from the local high school and went on to Anabuki Design College in Hiroshima City but dropped out. In an interview, Kubo has stated that he entered a magazine's manga contest, and that although he did not win, one of the magazine's editors noticed his talent. They subsequently worked together on joint projects. Not long afterward, his first manga short, "Ultra Unholy Hearted Machine", was published in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Special in 1996. This was followed by two more shorts, and in 1999 his first serial, Zombie Powder, began in Weekly Shonen Jump and ran for four volumes until 2000.

His next serial, Bleach, about a high school student who becomes a shinigami and fights evil spirits, Kubo submitted a manuscript of Bleach to Weekly Shonen Jump shortly after Zombie Powder ended hoping that it would be published; the story was rejected, since the editors claimed it was too similar to Togashi Yoshihiro’s YuYu Hakusho. Toriyama Akira, the creator of Dragon Ball, saw the story and sent a letter of encouragement to Kubo which inspired him to continue working on Bleach. The serialization began running in the same magazine in 2001, and an anime adaptation began running in Japan in 2004. The manga was named a winner of the Shogakukan Manga Award for its category in 2005.

description.en:
Midnight. Awakened by the echoing sound in my room, I was met with a frightening pair of "legs." Since then, as if wishing to merely make its presence known, it remained in my room without letting itself be seen. In the same way it was spreading its encircling net, little by little it encroached on my life until at last it appeared before me. Its true form was that of an exceedingly beautiful "nameless monster." Desperate resistance was futile as the monster dropped its hand towards me. I could not escape or resist. Hiding it from my skeptical lover and friends, thus opened the curtain to our strange life together. Quietly, the senses I had as a human were dying as my normal life continued to collapse. The moment I knew what was awaiting me, I was presented with an important decision.  
  
At the same time the monster first appeared before me, the public was disturbed by a string of bizarre murders. It was then that I began to wonder whether they and my beautiful yet eerie roommate were connected.
description.ru:
Полночь. Проснувшись от эха в моей комнате, я узрел пугающую пару «ног». С тех пор, словно желая просто заявить о своём присутствии, их обладатель остался в моей комнате, не давая себя увидеть. В тоже время он оплетал своей паутиной мой дом, понемногу вторгаясь в мою жизнь, пока, наконец, не появился передо мной. Его истинным обличьем оказался чрезвычайно красивый «безымянный монстр». Я не мог ни убежать, ни сопротивляться, когда монстр схватил меня. Скрывая это от моих скептически настроенных любимой и друзей, открываю занавес нашей странной совместной жизни. Когда я узнал, что меня ждет, я принял большое решение.  
С тех пор, как монстр впервые показался мне, общественность была обеспокоена чередой странных убийств. И я начал задаваться вопросом, могли они быть связаны с моим красивым, но жутким соседом по комнате.
description.pt-br:
Meia-noite. Acordado pelo som ecoando no meu quarto, fui recebido com um assustador par de "pernas". Desde então, como se quisesse apenas dar a conhecer a sua presença, ficou no meu quarto sem se deixar ver. Da mesma forma que estendia sua rede envolvente, pouco a pouco invadiu minha vida até que finalmente apareceu diante de mim. Sua verdadeira forma era a de um "monstro sem nome" extremamente belo. A resistência desesperada foi inútil quando o monstro baixou a mão em minha direção. Eu não podia escapar ou resistir. Escondendo isso de meu amante cético e amigos, assim abriu a cortina para nossa estranha vida juntos. Silenciosamente, os sentidos que eu tinha como humano estavam morrendo enquanto minha vida normal continuava a desmoronar. No momento em que soube o que me esperava, fui presenteado com uma decisão importante.

Ao mesmo tempo em que o monstro apareceu pela primeira vez diante de mim, o público foi perturbado por uma série de assassinatos bizarros. Foi então que comecei a me perguntar se eles e minha linda e misteriosa colega de quarto estavam conectados.

biography.en:
Tsutomu Nihei (弐瓶 勉, Nihei Tsutomu, born February 26, 1971) is a Japanese manga artist. Nihei has been drawing comics professionally since the mid-1990s. In 1995 he was awarded the Jiro Taniguchi Special Prize in that year's Afternoon Four Seasons Award for his submission, Blame. After working as an assistant to veteran comic artist Tsutomu Takahashi, Nihei went on to launch his debut series Blame! in Monthly Afternoon in 1997. Following the success of Blame!, he next penned Wolverine: Snikt! (published by Marvel Comics) and Biomega. In 2009, Nihei returned to Afternoon to launch what would become his most successful series, Knights of Sidonia. An architectural student, Nihei's early work were mainly wordless, relying on visuals and backgrounds to tell their stories. His cyberpunk-influenced artwork has gained a strong cult following worldwide.

He acted as Nokogiri Kuwagata in [Sidonia no Kishi: Daikyuu Wakusei Seneki](https://myanimelist.net/anime/24893/Sidonia_no_Kishi__Daikyuu_Wakusei_Seneki)(ep.06). Here is the [image](https://lain.bgm.tv/pic/crt/m/89/23/34363_crt_746kD.jpg?r=1437637618).

description.en: A single human Earthling arrives on an isolated planet inhabited by beastkin known as "Kemo," who are shaken to their cores at the sight of their first "Hito." Thus does their society begin to transform, spurred on by this interspecies exchange…
description.es: Un terrícola aterriza en un planeta remoto habitado por hombres bestia. Su presencia causa una gran conmoción, ya que nunca habían tenido contacto con un "humano". Sigue de cerca la transformación de su sociedad tras el encuentro con una especie desconocida.
description.fr: Sur une planète lointaine coupée du reste de l’univers vivent les « Kemos », des êtres à l’apparence animale qui n’ont encore jamais rencontré d’autre espèce que la leur. Mais lorsque survient l’arrivée inattendue d’un Terrien, la découverte de ce premier « Hito » bouleverse leur civilisation tout entière. Cette rencontre entre deux espèces que tout oppose marque le début d’une nouvelle ère dans laquelle leur monde s’apprête à connaître de profonds changements civilisationnels au contact de l'Hito lui-même... Sera-t-il source d'évolution ou de dévastation... ?
description.ja: ケモノが住む最果ての星に一人の地球人が訪れる。獣人たちは初めて目にする"ヒト"の姿に揺れ動く。異種族交流の中で変化するケモ社会・・・『アイアンナイト』、『レッドスプライト』の屋宜知宏が描くハートフル異種族観察物語!!
description.th: มีมนุษย์โลกมาเที่ยวหนึ่งดาวที่สุดท้ายที่เอเอสัตว์ร้ายอาศัยอยู่ สัตว์ร้ายเขย่าร่างกายของ "มนุษย์" ที่เพิ่งเห็นเป็นครั้งแรก สังเกตสัตวร้ายที่เปลี่ยนแปลงระหว่างการแลกเปลี่ยนข้ามพันธุ์.
description.vi: Một con người duy nhất từ Trái Đất đã đặt chân đến một hành tinh biệt lập, nơi sinh sống của chủng tộc thú nhân được gọi là "Kemo". Sự xuất hiện của "Hito" đầu tiên đã khiến cả xã hội của họ chấn động đến tận tâm can. Từ đó, xã hội của họ bắt đầu thay đổi, được thúc đẩy bởi cuộc giao thoa giữa hai chủng tộc khác biệt này…
description.pt-br: "Em um planeta remoto habitado por homens-fera conhecidos como ""Kemo"", um único humano vindo da Terra faz uma visita inesperada. Ao se depararem pela primeira vez com um ""Hito"", os habitantes têm suas convicções abaladas. Assim começa uma história de convivência entre espécies diferentes que transformará para sempre a sociedade dos Kemo."

**I became the strongest hero by frequenting the guild just to see the receptionist!**

Jade, who aims to become the strongest adventurer, arrives at the guild and falls in love at first sight with the receptionist! Determined to talk to her, he realizes the only way to do so is to complete as many quests as possible.

---
Jade, who was born in the countryside, came to the capital in hopes of becoming an adventurer and fell in love with a guild receptionist at first sight. He continued to go the guild for 10 years to get along with her, and Jade, who had garnered many achievements, had been hailed as a hero before he realized it. However, despite his wealth, fame, and power, he is a late bloomer and has only had formal conversations with the receptionist.

This is the story of Jade, who just wants to get along with the receptionist, and the people who see him take his work at the guild with the utmost seriousness, the "Selfless Hero."

Quando desperta, ela descobre que tanto ela quanto todo o centro de construção foram transportados para outro mundo — mais precisamente para o fundo da Masmorra de Melquodia, lar dos monstros mais ferozes imagináveis. description.en:
Mashiro Naomoto wants to have a taste of romance and even get to try lewd things, now that she has become a high school student.

However, she has low self-esteem and as a result of lacking confidence in herself, she began to think that it's probably impossible for her. Right at that moment, to her surprise a handsome male classmate named Oosagi-kun confesses to her. Mashiro starts to suspect that his confession must be some sort of punishment game, but her own desire to do lewd stuff wins over it and as a result, she does the opposite and makes a move on him... it's a case of sexual desire winning over suspicion!?

description.pt-br:
Mashiro Naomoto quer experimentar o romance e até tentar coisas pervertidas, agora que se tornou uma estudante do ensino médio**.

No entanto, ela tem baixa autoestima e, por falta de confiança em si mesma, começou a pensar que isso provavelmente seria impossível para ela. Nesse momento, para sua surpresa, um colega bonito chamado Oosagi-kun se declara para ela. Mashiro começa a suspeitar que a confissão dele seja algum tipo de jogo de punição, mas seu próprio desejo de fazer coisas pervertidas fala mais alto, e, como resultado, ela toma a iniciativa com ele... seria esse um caso de desejo sexual vencendo a desconfiança?!

Essa é uma comédia romântica onde a libido de uma garota do ensino médio vai correr solta!!

description.en:
"Reincarnated as a sub-character of a video game that I used to play!?"  
  
After saving a girl and then getting run over by a car in the process, and "I" was reincarnated as "Rex" in a video game world. A handsome Rex with skills in all fields, but he is a helper character in the early stages. Though Rex has a high level, balanced skill set and multitude of abilities… He's useless in the later stages of the game!!  
  
I decided in the face the fact that I'm useless in this fantasy world  
  
So let's relax by letting the main character of the game do both "saving the world" and fighting for his life against monsters"!　  
  
This is a story in which an ordinary person looking for a "hero" but instead becomes a hero who saves the world for some reason!
description.pt-br:
"Reencarnado como um sub-personagem de um videogame que eu costumava jogar !?"

Um belo Rex com habilidades em todos os campos, mas ele é um personagem auxiliar nos estágios iniciais. Tho Rex tem um alto nível, um conjunto de habilidades equilibrado e uma infinidade de habilidades ... Ele é inútil nas fases posteriores do jogo !!

Decidi na cara o fato de que sou um inútil neste mundo de fantasia

Então vamos relaxar deixando o personagem principal do jogo fazer tanto "salvar o mundo" quanto lutar por sua vida contra monstros "!　

Esta é uma história em que um pessoa comum procurando por um "herói", mas ao invés disso se torna um herói que salva o mundo por algum motivo!

When he turned fourteen, a beautiful priestess, Lunamaria, visits the mountain and says that Will is destined to be a Hero. To save the world, Will needs to go on a journey with her.

Is he really the savior of the world? Would he be able to find where he came from? Thus, the journey begins...!
